# QuotaBurn

> Agent cost & usage-limit tracker: plans, usage limits and per-token API prices for AI coding agents, each with an official source URL and last-verified date (data verified 2026-10-13).

## Data
- [Full dataset (JSON)](https://quotaburn.com/data.json)
- [Model API prices](https://quotaburn.com/models/)

## Tools
- [Claude Code pricing & limits](https://quotaburn.com/tools/claude-code/)
- [Cursor pricing & limits](https://quotaburn.com/tools/cursor/)
- [OpenAI Codex pricing & limits](https://quotaburn.com/tools/openai-codex/)
- [GitHub Copilot pricing & limits](https://quotaburn.com/tools/github-copilot/)
- [Windsurf (now Devin Desktop) pricing & limits](https://quotaburn.com/tools/windsurf-devin-desktop/)
- [Devin pricing & limits](https://quotaburn.com/tools/devin/)
- [Gemini CLI pricing & limits](https://quotaburn.com/tools/gemini-cli/)

## Guides
- [Cut your agent bill](https://quotaburn.com/cut-your-agent-bill/)
- [Methodology](https://quotaburn.com/methodology/)

## Quick facts
- Claude Fable 5.1 (Anthropic): $10 input / $50 output per 1M tokens (verified 2026-10-13, https://claude.com/pricing)
- Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic): $4 input / $20 output per 1M tokens (verified 2026-10-13, https://claude.com/pricing)
